relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP directly acts on B cells through its receptor CALCRL-RAMP1 via the cyclic AMP (cAMP) signaling pathway

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Activating nociceptors by ingesting capsaicin enhances the splenic GC response and anti-influenza immunity.

key_findings: Spleen-innervating DRG nociceptors are activated by PGE2, release CGRP, and promote germinal center responses via CALCRL-RAMP1 on B cells.
